question: Can one positive isotropic Gaussian PSF scale per VISION3 stock/channel convert BU0's source-domain MTF diversity into a held-frequency explicit operator bank that materially beats shared and wrong-stock scales?

protocol.candidate: per-stock per-channel exp(-2*pi^2*(sigma_mm*f)^2) positive Gaussian MTF
protocol.shared_control: one sigma per channel fit jointly across all development stocks
protocol.selection_metric: development mean squared absolute response error
protocol.confirmation_metric: root mean squared absolute response error

allowed_after_pass: retain a versioned source-domain stock/channel Gaussian-PSF parameter bank
freeze a separate typed physical-scale compiler that keeps the spatial execution domain unresolved
forbidden: change the family, grid, split, controls or gates after confirmation scoring
add a second Gaussian, delta component, sharpening lobe, negative tap or fitted gain
render photographs or choose exposure/density/transmittance/scan placement in this leaf
infer colour response, roll calibration, scanner response, grain or product look
change B0/AO6 or train a stock/router selector

branch_rule.pass: Retain an isolated stock-specific positive-PSF source prior; placement and photographic value require separate evidence.
branch_rule.fail: Close this exact one-Gaussian stock bank without capacity, split, grid or gate rescue.

claim_ceiling: Held-frequency compatibility of a simple positive Gaussian PSF with three first-party VISION3 MTF graphs; not real-roll calibration, complete film MTF, placement, photographic appearance or product integration.
